mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tradingsystem.price_alerts ( account_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, triggered_on, created_on, updated_on ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{direction}, #{threshold}, #{status}, #{triggeredOn}, COALESCE(#{createdOn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedOn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, triggered_on, created_on, updated_on FROM tradingsystem.price_alerts WHERE id = #{alertId}
SELECT id, account_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, triggered_on, created_on, updated_on FROM tradingsystem.price_alerts WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND id = #{alertId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tradingsystem.price_alerts WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, account_id, symbol, direction, threshold, status, triggered_on, created_on, updated_on FROM tradingsystem.price_alerts WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY threshold ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tradingsystem.price_alerts SET status = #{status}, triggered_on = #{triggeredOn}, updated_on = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND id = #{alertId}
